page.overview:
What is Baoht Z'uqqa-Mogg?

Baoht Z'uqqa-Mogg (The Bringer of the Pestilence) is a powerful winged scorpion-like monstrosity with an ant-like head. It is worshipped by small conclaves of ghouls. Baoht also lived on Shaggai, a planet that was destroyed by the Outer God Ghroth. This being is currently dwelling on Earth. It most likely has no human worshippers.

Category:Great Old Ones Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
